name: lain-psx-decompiled
description: Decompile and port Serial Experiments Lain PSX to native Windows, macOS, and Linux with a byte-identical executable.

paragraphs: Have you ever wanted to experience the mysterious world of Serial Experiments Lain on your current computer? This project brings the original PlayStation game back to life with a native client that runs beautifully on Windows, macOS, and Linux. No emulators, no complicated setup — just download, run, and dive into the unsettling digital landscape of the Wired.
features: Native Performance — Runs directly on your operating system without needing separate emulation software. This means smoother graphics, faster loading times, and better overall stability.
Cross-Platform Freedom — Whether you use Windows, macOS, or Linux, this client works right out of the box. No more hunting for platform-specific solutions.

Faithful Recreation — The game has been meticulously decompiled from the original PlayStation code, preserving every line of dialogue, every visual effect, and every haunting sound exactly as it was meant to be…
No Technical Knowledge Required — If you can click a button, you can play this game. We've removed all the technical barriers that normally come with running retro software.
Active Community — Join other fans who are rediscovering this classic. Share tips, ask questions, and connect with fellow Lain enthusiasts.
